reviews.comment: She is a very nice and approachable professor. She loves to help and guide you through your reading and writing experience in the class. Do the reading, show up to class and take notes and you will be fine.

TAKE HER IF YOU HAVE THE CHANCE! I genuinely do not have enough nice things to say about this woman. I was going through a tough time during this class, and she could not have been more understanding. The class is 2 750-word essays, 2 small projects, and a final. She actually cares about her students, is so helpful, and really wants you to learn.

TAKE THIS CLASS! Dr. Sperrazza made my whole semester. She is an incredible professor, and she genuinely cares. Show up to class, actually do the readings (they are short and very digestible), and you will learn so much. You get out what you put in, and I would take it again. No exams, graded journal and participation, group project & final paper!

SUCH AN AMAZING PROF!! She is so caring and has very engaging lectures! The excerpts she picked for us to read were doable and not overwhelming, and I actually enjoyed coming to class and discussing them. There were only three grades: a final paper, a group presentation, and a reflection journal over the readings. I couldn't recommend her enough!!

This was the BEST English class I have ever taken. Dr. Sperrazza is brilliant. The classes are discussion based, and she is incredible at facilitating. The readings are not long. I can't say enough good things about her. You are graded on very few things, and have a paper at the end of the semester that she offers workshops for. TAKE THIS CLASS!!!
